title: IBAMA infraction notices, Legal Amazon states only (example of a data cut)

source.license_note: IBAMA open data; cite the source when reusing

series.name: notices
series.description: Number of infraction notices issued in the month in the nine Legal Amazon states (non-cancelled)

series.name: fine_total_brl
series.description: Total value of fines issued in the month in the nine Legal Amazon states (non-cancelled); nominal values in the currency of the time: no inflation adjustment, and Brazil changed currency five times before the Real (July 1994)

domain: IBAMA, Brazil's federal environmental agency, publishes every infraction notice (auto de infracao) it issues. This cut keeps only notices issued in the nine Legal Amazon states (AC, AM, AP, MA, MT, PA, RO, RR, TO), where the dry season (roughly June to September) concentrates deforestation and fire enforcement.

categories.PDC: Policy-Driven Change: legislation, mandate, agency restructuring or political transition
categories.SP: Seasonal Pattern: a recurring annual enforcement cycle
categories.DQE: Data-Quality Event: reporting failure, system migration, backlog, duplication or retroactive correction
categories.GES: Genuine Enforcement Shift: a real change in enforcement intensity not explained by the above
